title: Pay $48 and claim lifetime access to AI apps: How to compare ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini
excerpt: Upgrade your AI workflow with five lifetime software licenses.
content_html:
TL;DR: Simplify your AI workflow with The Lifetime AI Software Stack Bundle, on sale now for just $47.99 (reg. $1,811.99) with code DEAL20 through Nov. 15.

Credit: The Lifetime AI Software Stack Bundle

$47.99
$1,811.99 Save $1,764

Not every AI model is equally good at everything. One might be better for research, another better for writing, and yet another helpful for creating images. If you want to improve your AI workflow, the Lifetime AI Software Stack Bundle provides five tools to tackle a wide range of projects and access multiple models.

Say goodbye to your AI subscriptions and snag The Lifetime AI Software Stack Bundle for only $47.99.

Get a whole lineup of AI tools for just $48

ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini might be the first AI model that comes to mind, but there are countless options. The Lifetime AI Software Stack Bundle brings many of them to you — providing five lifetime tools ready to help with everything from basic questions to image generation.

First up in this bundle? 1ForAll AI Pro, which helps you tackle text, voice, image, and video generation. This tool uses models from OpenAI, Google, AWS, Azure, and Luma to handle your voice cloning, PDF-to-speech, and unlimited text processing needs.

The best tech deal this week

The Apple iPhone 18 Pro is free right now with T-Mobile

Need help with queries? PromptBuilder Starter is a Chrome extension that helps you craft perfect prompts optimized for 10 different AI tools. This lifetime license even gives you up to 5,000 queries per month for life.

AskAnyModel AI is there to give you a wide range of answers from up to six different AI models at once. Ask your query and check out results from models like Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and more — all side-by-side so you can easily pick the best one for your needs.

If you could use a little more time back, Voibe is here to serve as your very own voice-to-text transcription service, saving you time on typing. Dictate into Word, Outlook, Gmail, Google Docs, Slack, and more, on both Mac and Windows devices.

Mashable Deals

By signing up, you agree to receive recurring automated SMS marketing messages from Mashable Deals at the number provided. Msg and data rates may apply. Up to 2 messages/day. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Consent is not a condition of purchase. See our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.

Leelo AI completes this bundle of AI tools, and if you’re a content creator, you need this one. It’s a voice-to-text narration partner that helps you create audio for everything from audiobooks to social media. It’s capable of generating speech in 142 languages, all with authentic accents.

Snag the Lifetime AI Software Stack Bundle for only $47.99 with code DEAL20 now through Nov. 15.
